findings.title: Validation split overlaps with the training data
findings.quote:
train_rows = load('train.csv')
val_rows = load('train.csv')
assert len(train_rows) == len(val_rows)
findings.claim: The validation loader reads the training file.
findings.concern: Every validation example was already seen during training.

verification.note: The CSV lists the overlapping row count.

findings.title: Missing ablation for the central component
findings.quote:
model = build_model(use_component=True)
history = fit(model, train_rows)
print(history)
findings.claim: The central component is never removed.
findings.concern: The reported gain cannot be attributed to the component.
findings.resolution: Add an ablation without the component.
